definitions.explanation: A cereal grain used to make flour for bread, pasta, and other foods.

notes:
{小麦|こむぎ} refers to wheat as a grain crop, distinct from ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧ (rice).

WRITING:
Literally "small wheat" - contrasts with ⟦{大麦|おおむぎ}→大麦：12215_oomugi⟧ (barley, "large wheat").

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧: wheat flour (the most common derivative)
- {小麦|こむぎ}⟦{畑|ばたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧: wheat field
- ⟦{全粒|ぜんりゅう}→全粒：noentry⟧{小麦|こむぎ}: whole wheat
- {小麦|こむぎ}⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧: wheat allergy

USAGE:
Japan imports most of its wheat, primarily from the US, Canada, and Australia. ⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧ is used for ⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧, ⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧, bread, and many other foods.
